action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE ISSUE: The application code for FIX 1 (health probe endpoints) is 100% correct. The unprefixed /health and /healthz routes are properly registered in server.py (lines 762-765) and work perfectly on localhost:8001. However, the Kubernetes ingress is routing these unprefixed paths to the frontend instead of the backend, causing the deployment health probes to fail. The ingress configuration must be updated to route /health and /healthz to backend:8001. This is NOT an application code issue - it's an infrastructure/deployment configuration issue that requires ingress rule changes outside the application codebase. FIX 2 (URL validation) is working perfectly - all specified URLs are correctly accepted/rejected in the browser. Regarding the user's 403 issue: I successfully completed a GitHub scan with no 403 error, suggesting the user encountered GitHub's 60-requests-per-hour unauthenticated rate limit (which returns 403). The app handles this gracefully with error code GitHubAccessDenied and a clear message directing users to add a token or wait.
